name: rosbag2_go2_map_benchmark01
description: A dataset of ROS(2) bag recordings packaged for evaluating mapping and localization pipelines. It provides synchronized sensor streams and ground-truth poses/maps to measure SLAM/mapping and navigation performance. Intended to benchmark map consistency, trajectory accuracy and localization robustness under realistic robot data.
evaluation_method: Absolute Pose Error (APE) / Relative Pose Error (RPE) / trajectory RMSE / map overlap (IoU)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset with limited community adoption to date, primarily of interest to robotics and SLAM practitioners.
